Questions

Everything You Want to
Know First

50% upfront to begin, 50% on delivery before handover. We accept payment via Flutterwave (card, bank transfer, USSD) or direct bank transfer on request. Retainer payments are monthly at the start of each billing cycle.
Yes — we need collaborator access to build and publish the design. This is a limited permission level. We cannot access your payouts or billing. You can revoke it instantly at any time.
Both. The Launch Package is designed for new brands starting from scratch. Growth Accelerator and Scale System work for existing stores needing a serious upgrade. The free call helps us figure out the right fit.
For a new store: your logo, brand colours, product images, and any inspiration references. For a redesign: access to your existing store. We guide you through everything on the strategy call — you don't need it all figured out beforehand.
We guarantee a professionally built, conversion-optimised store delivered on time. Specific revenue figures depend on your product, pricing, and traffic. What we can say: a properly designed store consistently outperforms a poorly designed one — which is why we offer the free call first.
